chains_with.description: Code review findings feed the autofix remediation workflow as its required review input.

evidence: CodeRabbit Code Review produces agent-readable severity-grouped findings (clm_f5022775d155); CodeRabbit Autofix requires a completed CodeRabbit review with unresolved current root threads (clm_10a9c7605ab4) to begin remediation.
subject: skl_coderabbit-code-review-src-https-github-com-codera-9e16a0ae-lls-8f2a22eb-skills-code-review-skill-md_9e16a0ae

alternatives.context_note: Choose Autofix when the goal is governed remediation of CodeRabbit findings in sensitive repos; choose Code Review when the goal is triage of findings into tasks without fix governance.

evidence: CodeRabbit Code Review analysis (clm_ad54044355c7) states Autofix is the stronger choice for autonomous remediation; Autofix analysis (clm_66346ff946a3) prefers this skill over generic review fixers for sensitive repositories.
subject: skl_coderabbit-autofix-src-https-github-com-coderabbit-7ec3dc4b-skills-8f2a22eb-skills-autofix-skill-md_7ec3dc4b
